q1_issues.issue: (Symmetric Word) is a head-level claim that every (Word x y) atom holds both ways, but "is a word for" is not symmetric in general — only the synonymy reading of this particular sentence makes it so.

q2_gaps: metalinguistic / synonymy predication ("X is another word for Y", "X means Y", "X is called Y") — the instruction set has no representation for a claim about words and no use/mention distinction, so the parse can only reuse the object-level concept symbols cartography / mapmaking
additive "another" (presupposing the other term is itself a word) — the focus section covers only "also / too / as well"
notes: The head Word rides the one open-class licence (a Symmetric-tagged mutual predicate the copula asserts to hold both ways), so it is licensed, though every example of that pattern is a relation between individuals. Emitting no typing atoms for cartography / mapmaking is correct — bare kind-denoting constants, as in the kind-relation examples.
